cards.stem: In steady descent what expression equals lift times sine of glide angle?
options: drag times the cosine of the glide angle
cards.quote: The lift times the sine of the glide angle is equal to the drag times the cosine of the glide angle.
cards.hint: Recall how horizontal and vertical force parts cancel

cards.stem: Which equation form shows steady glide force balance along the flight direction?
cards.hint: Think of components parallel to glide path

cards.stem: How does the page describe motion with no acceleration while losing height?
options: steady (constant velocity and no acceleration) descent
cards.quote: If a glider is in a steady (constant velocity and no acceleration) descent, it loses altitude as it travels.
cards.hint: Focus on the definition of unaccelerated sinking flight

cards.stem: What sum balances weight in the steady glide vector equation?
